about: Accepted differences between nuBuilder and nuBuilder Next for dev/tests/compat.js. kind: value (edit form field), cell (browse cell id), column (table column after a save). form / field: regex (* = any form). nub / next: optional regex the two values must match. Every entry needs a reason.

known.reason: helper elements of the page (Tom Select search box, file upload parts) – not a field value
nuBuilder Next: format option 'negative' = brackets / red_brackets (Formats page) – nuBuilder has no such option and shows a minus
nuBuilder Next shows the suffix of a number format (1000.0 %) – nuBuilder drops it
